steps.name: Before Hooks
Open home page and navigate to promo page
Navigate to USA promo page
Open Mattamy Homes home page for USA in PROD
Closed the AtlasRTX chat iframe before clicking
Navigating to promo ENV=PROD | COUNTRY=USA | URL=https://www.mattamyhomes.com/florida/orlando/promos/hometown-heroes
Verify promo page loads with expected content
Verify USA promo page loaded
Promo URL should match the configured route
Promo page should have a title
Promo page title Mattamy Homes | Hometown Heroes | Orlando, FL
Promo page title should name the orlando market
Promo hero image should be visible
Promo heading should be visible
Promo heading A Special Thank You to Our Hometown Heroes
Closed the AtlasRTX chat iframe before clicking
Offer disclaimer modal covered the page closed
Verify promo form fields are visible
Verify promo form fields
Promo form title should be visible
Promo lead form should be visible
Community of Interest field should be visible
First name field should be visible
Last name field should be visible
Email field should be visible
Country field should be visible
Zip/Postal Code field should be visible
Phone number field should be visible
Promo form submit button should be visible
